notes: τὴν γυναῖκα has no genitive pronoun beside it and the verse's αὐτοῦ tokens are already spent, so rule 20's second arm (with rule 76's availability test) gives the supplied *his* to the article; the two articles that do stand beside a free αὐτοῦ are unrepresented.
ὅτι is unrepresented under rule 43, the ASV writing the quoted statute with no complementizer.
